info.title: AgentCost API
info.description:
Track LLM costs in your AI applications.

AgentCost records every LLM call with model, tokens, cost, latency and status, then reports spend by agent, workflow, project and model.

**Public, no credentials required:** everything under `/v1/pricing` (the model catalogue and its per-1k rates) and `/v1/health`.

**Everything else** needs either a project API key (`Authorization: Bearer sk_...`) or a session token plus a `project_id`.

Errors return a structured envelope: `error.code`, `error.message`, `error.hint`.

servers.description: AgentCost API (origin). Sleeps when idle; a cold request can take ~60s.
Cached mirror on the website. Serves the public read endpoints and the cost estimator, and does not sleep.

post.description:
Register a new user account.

- **email**: Valid email address (must be unique)
- **password**: Min 8 chars, must include uppercase, lowercase, and number
- **name**: Optional display name
- **accept_terms**: Must be true - explicit consent to Terms of Service
- **accept_privacy**: Must be true - explicit consent to Privacy Policy
- **terms_version**: Version of Terms being accepted (e.g., "1.0")
- **privacy_version**: Version of Privacy Policy being accepted (e.g., "1.0")

Legal consent is recorded with timestamp, IP address, and user agent for audit compliance.

The user is logged in immediately: the response includes the same token payload
as /login, plus a default project (API key shown ONCE) and whether the
verification email was actually sent.
